findings.current: As everyone stood there, stunned, the fourth prince alone rose to his feet and stepped onto the stage prepared for him, his expression calm.
findings.defect: The draft has everyone standing, although the fourth prince alone rises.
findings.rationale: 홀로 일어선 singles out the fourth prince’s action; the others are described as shocked, not standing.
findings.replacement: As everyone looked on in shock, the fourth prince alone rose to his feet and stepped onto the stage prepared for him, his expression calm.
findings.source: 하나같이 경악을 금치 못하는 좌중 속에서 홀로 일어선 사 황자는 담담한 얼굴로 자신을 위해 준비된 무대에 올랐다.

findings.current: I looked from Hong Jin to the black figure that had appeared in midair, then spoke.
findings.defect: “In midair” places the figure above the ground; the source says it appeared out of empty air.
findings.rationale: 텅 빈 허공에서 나타난 describes its sudden appearance, not a suspended position.
findings.replacement: I looked back and forth between Hong Jin and the black figure that had appeared out of thin air, then spoke.
findings.source: 텅 빈 허공에서 나타난 검은 인영(人影)과 홍진을 번갈아 바라보던 나는 입을 열었다.

findings.current: How did the fourth prince, already pushed out of the line of succession, manage to seize the throne of a Great Nation?
findings.defect: “Pushed out of the line of succession” implies he was no longer eligible; the source says he had lost ground in the succession struggle.
findings.rationale: 후계 구도에서 밀려난 describes his disadvantaged position, not formal removal from succession.
findings.replacement: How did the fourth prince, already sidelined in the struggle for succession, manage to seize the throne of a Great Nation?
findings.source: 이미 후계 구도에서 밀려난 네 번째 황자가 어떻게 대국의 황위(皇位)을 손에 넣을 수 있었을까?

findings.current: Only thirteen—and already able to make the Commander of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, a man who can bring down flying birds, bow his head.
findings.defect: The bird image is rendered as a literal ability rather than an expression of the commander’s power.
findings.rationale: 나는 새도 떨어트리는 emphasizes formidable influence; the point is that even such a man bows to the prince.
findings.replacement: Only thirteen—and already able to make the Commander of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, a man whose influence could knock birds from the sky, bow his head.
findings.source: 나는 새도 떨어트리는 금의위 지휘사를 고개 숙이게 만들고

findings.current: I failed as a servant because I didn’t realize there was a rebellion, and I was powerless because all I could do was watch it happen.
findings.defect: “Servant” makes Hong Jin’s failure sound domestic rather than a failure of duty to his sovereign.
findings.rationale: 신하로서 invokes his political duty, while 무능 and 무력 form a deliberate contrast.
findings.replacement: I was incompetent as a subject: I failed to detect the treason. And I was powerless: all I could do was watch it happen.
findings.source: 역모를 알아차리지 못했으니 신하로서 무능(無能)했고, 그 모든 것을 그저 바라만 볼 수밖에 없었으니 무력(無力)했지.

findings.current: In fact, when dealing with Jeong Hogun and the other guards, or the East Depot eunuchs, he’d even seemed amused.
findings.defect: “Seemed amused” softens his openly scornful reaction.
findings.rationale: 비웃음마저 내비쳤었다 indicates that he let his derision show.
findings.replacement: In fact, when dealing with Jeong Hogun and the other guards, or the East Depot eunuchs, he’d even shown open contempt.
findings.source: 실제로 정호군을 위시한 여타 금의위들이나 동창의 환관들을 상대하면서도 비웃음마저 내비쳤었다.

findings.current: At a time when you should be bending over backward to please the Emperor, handing him your gallbladder and your liver,
findings.defect: The literal organ list appended to an English idiom is awkward and obscures the point.
findings.rationale: 간과 쓸개까지 빼 주며 비위를 맞추다 is emphatic imagery for going to extremes to curry favor; the English idiom carries that meaning.
findings.replacement: At a time when you should be bending over backward to please the Emperor,
findings.source: 황제에게 간과 쓸개까지 빼 주며 비위를 맞춰야 할 판국에

summary: Several passages alter physical staging or political meaning; others flatten Hong Jin’s register or read unnaturally.
